Acetaldehyde is `a toxic intermediate byproduct formed when the body breaks down alcohol (ethanol)` . Most of this process happens in the liver in two main enzymatic steps.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXKs2UmO65vpR21tlUGafuOTWVWMmJVrFTd9Axm06bJ4Em4H89UhMxvpMKLaS8HeQ1Q4W2NdlilWxXNSHVHynSgTo_M6ZBoxRijhcju3BqDaE-ErZGZa4aV28ZOu6nR8iUmk6jZJImV1QAgES_3j6Rzlw)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ArwZfswz9sc)

### Step-by-Step Breakdown

- **Ethanol to Acetaldehyde:** The enzyme **alcohol dehydrogenase (ADH)** converts ethanol into acetaldehyde, mainly in the liver (with smaller amounts in the stomach and other tissues). Minor pathways involving CYP2E1 and catalase also contribute.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1xf4n9zyolPO9jhQgxElKCGTQlx_PR3T2aJRD4mzwMBRMXpm-CWK0MQ4aEy8Hlfj0rBJK_kM6TosUN9rdeCFIpXTG6sx5ybfrKRxuEYFWjQZY30xAjH-Ar2g1OQNGIVMiHQdkF96v5iJd7-MMXbJqPrX0tLHwJanmWg7bypQt0OH1lD0AJ4xqGbtLLk9T0ibloXVoxJ6w5r6Cmom)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXKs2UmO65vpR21tlUGafuOTWVWMmJVrFTd9Axm06bJ4Em4H89UhMxvpMKLaS8HeQ1Q4W2NdlilWxXNSHVHynSgTo_M6ZBoxRijhcju3BqDaE-ErZGZa4aV28ZOu6nR8iUmk6jZJImV1QAgES_3j6Rzlw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1AEBxCJF16VWnX1QX-xXq49sdS8xvUBhYypf5jbf1-km8nPlhBq3OTh8t21ehzeaM8wZMOaOCSRnMlDQT-6I_k85g42mJawC187_gNO-lNWHBXZF2hMke9T1ZR9rizhr8gzER2xTuKFbF2YG8kwgIoLsXWfPmX_EJPiyTdSF17iLasUFrNh8DZ_ibpkkPV9dmVgkRMxsHxMqPgYM2QEyt8AdARSKS2we03ZqZJDC5eEs7TsWTJOGL4MTuIfScGfXjDcu1GJ_mFxONUsHZkbASYMmevWWjw)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Imd5SaPbgjM&t=174)
- **Acetaldehyde to Acetate:** The enzyme **aldehyde dehydrogenase (ALDH)** —especially mitochondrial ALDH2—rapidly converts toxic acetaldehyde into less harmful acetate.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF177HX7-g0Q4ZfvE-zWGcvSqHdDgMdqxsVmLd5W6-8CNi1nfwq1GjgwL_8jfxuhbhAQ5yJrooPv2WYO3KYI_wozALrYgS8i-Wf05IHhKYZyYZgl1R2ibg-uihcEx8AClseIeGDS5VI_Jhm3CLNZQKANabcgL6odwokj7sKA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXKs2UmO65vpR21tlUGafuOTWVWMmJVrFTd9Axm06bJ4Em4H89UhMxvpMKLaS8HeQ1Q4W2NdlilWxXNSHVHynSgTo_M6ZBoxRijhcju3BqDaE-ErZGZa4aV28ZOu6nR8iUmk6jZJImV1QAgES_3j6Rzlw)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ArwZfswz9sc)
- **Final Clearance:** Acetate enters the bloodstream and is broken down into carbon dioxide and water, largely outside the liver.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXKs2UmO65vpR21tlUGafuOTWVWMmJVrFTd9Axm06bJ4Em4H89UhMxvpMKLaS8HeQ1Q4W2NdlilWxXNSHVHynSgTo_M6ZBoxRijhcju3BqDaE-ErZGZa4aV28ZOu6nR8iUmk6jZJImV1QAgES_3j6Rzlw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF177HX7-g0Q4ZfvE-zWGcvSqHdDgMdqxsVmLd5W6-8CNi1nfwq1GjgwL_8jfxuhbhAQ5yJrooPv2WYO3KYI_wozALrYgS8i-Wf05IHhKYZyYZgl1R2ibg-uihcEx8AClseIeGDS5VI_Jhm3CLNZQKANabcgL6odwokj7sKA)

For a clear overview of the pathway and health effects, see the [National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXKs2UmO65vpR21tlUGafuOTWVWMmJVrFTd9Axm06bJ4Em4H89UhMxvpMKLaS8HeQ1Q4W2NdlilWxXNSHVHynSgTo_M6ZBoxRijhcju3BqDaE-ErZGZa4aV28ZOu6nR8iUmk6jZJImV1QAgES_3j6Rzlw).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXKs2UmO65vpR21tlUGafuOTWVWMmJVrFTd9Axm06bJ4Em4H89UhMxvpMKLaS8HeQ1Q4W2NdlilWxXNSHVHynSgTo_M6ZBoxRijhcju3BqDaE-ErZGZa4aV28ZOu6nR8iUmk6jZJImV1QAgES_3j6Rzlw)

### Why Acetaldehyde Matters

- **Toxicity and Cancer Risk:** Acetaldehyde damages proteins, lipids, and DNA, and is classified as a known carcinogen.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjAEBxCJF1xwEceGKOo_Jf362bdJ2nxrg8s_6gxxry60nvIQmwDhsXWNl3DPEm958tic16SSD5PzuLVQPU-WOc_6Nwq52XwUZ7mk4AJ1blqVRZ7F22YefBL4Bu-9V6s3WSvZS67ly59iLj1aMGse-4eyUbJz9JLdVxxIBiDyTLQqmafk3VDexwZARZ8ru-g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXKs2UmO65vpR21tlUGafuOTWVWMmJVrFTd9Axm06bJ4Em4H89UhMxvpMKLaS8HeQ1Q4W2NdlilWxXNSHVHynSgTo_M6ZBoxRijhcju3BqDaE-ErZGZa4aV28ZOu6nR8iUmk6jZJImV1QAgES_3j6Rzlw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1xf4n9zyolPO9jhQgxElKCGTQlx_PR3T2aJRD4mzwMBRMXpm-CWK0MQ4aEy8Hlfj0rBJK_kM6TosUN9rdeCFIpXTG6sx5ybfrKRxuEYFWjQZY30xAjH-Ar2g1OQNGIVMiHQdkF96v5iJd7-MMXbJqPrX0tLHwJanmWg7bypQt0OH1lD0AJ4xqGbtLLk9T0ibloXVoxJ6w5r6Cmom)
- **Flush Reaction and Intolerance:** If ALDH2 works slowly or is inactive, acetaldehyde builds up in the body. This causes facial flushing, nausea, rapid heart rate, and discomfort—often called [alcohol intolerance](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXX9RoGP8ZNsJwVYg4LJ9V5gQmUq7yD3TnH9M9U-04sBT7N30ECdyXizTr87473wgRWEvMjlNPk3zeDFdwTUsaEfEeG6BPohxtUcfN9o2MJnx0WftZk9V__3aCDceVGpXXHVp_1cuZX0Y3-) or the alcohol flush reaction.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXgbAYgNOK7eHqvsMy66xO8-CuUyxjD9k78CvbW_UxZsE9WiqcKn3qysb7tHDh0l5k0g11XVrPNX7ew6rGeeEYx6uoo2N3RQJyeNKrNtAiVKjEHC9D8mRlFZp6Z_bCszU3TMAlEFbRh6L9)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXeDHb5gVJxPQMYgUocd3gphLDXozg2X1uzhTeDBYTsDz3YOBf2NDur_aLh92jCL-Sw6O2hef6VFOXzR8cNdLQ2-IaFBpYpj4jiXf9ZcVJd1YqeBexIzJFTAegNmB1RgSDjJF8HrkrR7r0-27V5g61yw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1AEBxCJF16VWnX1QX-xXq49sdS8xvUBhYypf5jbf1-km8nPlhBq3OTh8t21ehzeaM8wZMOaOCSRnMlDQT-6I_k85g42mJawC187_gNO-lNWHBXZF2hMke9T1ZR9rizhr8gzER2xTuKFbF2YG8kwgIoLsXWfPmX_EJPiyTdSF17iLasUFrNh8DZ_ibpkkPV9dmVgkRMxsHxMqPgYM2QEyt8AdARSKS2we03ZqZJDC5eEs7TsWTJOGL4MTuIfScGfXjDcu1GJ_mFxONUsHZkbASYMmevWWjw)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjAEBxCJF1xwEceGKOo_Jf362bdJ2nxrg8s_6gxxry60nvIQmwDhsXWNl3DPEm958tic16SSD5PzuLVQPU-WOc_6Nwq52XwUZ7mk4AJ1blqVRZ7F22YefBL4Bu-9V6s3WSvZS67ly59iLj1aMGse-4eyUbJz9JLdVxxIBiDyTLQqmafk3VDexwZARZ8ru-g)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXX9RoGP8ZNsJwVYg4LJ9V5gQmUq7yD3TnH9M9U-04sBT7N30ECdyXizTr87473wgRWEvMjlNPk3zeDFdwTUsaEfEeG6BPohxtUcfN9o2MJnx0WftZk9V__3aCDceVGpXXHVp_1cuZX0Y3-)
- **Medications and Hangovers:** Drugs like disulfiram block ALDH to deter drinking by causing acetaldehyde buildup. Acetaldehyde accumulation also contributes to hangover symptoms alongside dehydration and other factors. For more on how this connects to morning-after symptoms, read [McGill Office for Science and Society](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXeDHb5gVJxPQMYgUocd3gphLDXozg2X1uzhTeDBYTsDz3YOBf2NDur_aLh92jCL-Sw6O2hef6VFOXzR8cNdLQ2-IaFBpYpj4jiXf9ZcVJd1YqeBexIzJFTAegNmB1RgSDjJF8HrkrR7r0-27V5g61yw).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXeDHb5gVJxPQMYgUocd3gphLDXozg2X1uzhTeDBYTsDz3YOBf2NDur_aLh92jCL-Sw6O2hef6VFOXzR8cNdLQ2-IaFBpYpj4jiXf9ZcVJd1YqeBexIzJFTAegNmB1RgSDjJF8HrkrR7r0-27V5g61yw)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ArwZfswz9sc)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TCBW-Nidevk&t=40)

items.title: Why Acetaldehyde Matters
items.text: Toxicity and Cancer Risk: Acetaldehyde damages proteins, lipids, and DNA, and is classified as a known carcinogen. Flush Reaction and Intolerance: If ALDH2 works slowly or is inactive, acetaldehyde builds up in the body. This causes facial flushing, nausea, rapid heart rate, and discomfort—often called alcohol intolerance or the alcohol flush reaction. Medications and Hangovers: Drugs like disulfiram block ALDH to deter drinking by causing acetaldehyde buildup. Acetaldehyde accumulation also contributes to hangover symptoms alongside dehydration and other factors. For more on how this connects to morning-after symptoms, read McGill Office for Science and Society.
